0a1ebf.title: Initial orchestration plan for httpbin.org
0a1ebf.content:
Single in-scope black-box target: `https://httpbin.org`.

Planned workflow:
- Delegate bounded reconnaissance and endpoint mapping first.
- Use recon results to identify concrete input surfaces and supported methods.
- Fan out focused validation agents for the highest-value classes that fit the discovered surface: SSRF, XSS, auth/session/JWT, IDOR/BOLA, injection, CSRF, and business-logic abuse.
- Require reporting agents to file only fully validated findings.
- Review all completed findings for attack chaining before finalizing the scan.
